pool.text: Raymond IV left with his army to join the First Crusade.
The notables of Toulouse obtained autonomy and created a municipal body.
Saint Dominic founded a mendicant order in the city of Toulouse.
King Louis VIII of France intervened to tip the balance.
The University of Toulouse was established in the year twelve hundred and twenty nine.
The Consistori del Gay Saber was created to preserve lyric art.
Toulouse was chosen to become a balancing metropolis for the country.
An old water-tower was converted as a gallery by a photographer.
Line A of the underground transportation system was opened in Toulouse.
The Canal du Midi was designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Sernin and the former hospital were designated alongside the pilgrimage route.
An explosion occurred at the AZF fertiliser factory causing casualties.
Toulouse has been the French city with the fastest growing GDP.
Line B opened to serve stations from north to south in Toulouse.
A citywide bicycle rental scheme called VélôToulouse was introduced.
The tramway line T1 entered into service for urban transport.
A territorial reform made Toulouse the regional prefecture of Occitanie.
The last completed A380 aircraft was produced here in this city.
The city of Toulouse introduced a new mode of public transportation.
Toulouse was named a UNESCO City of Music within the creative network.
